process_type: Dual-track: (1) court-supervised marketing & sale of some/all assets on a going-concern basis, run in parallel with (2) an orderly liquidation/monetization of inventory and receivables. Both tracks proceed simultaneously, not sequentially, per the First Day Declaration.
investment_banker: Portage Point Partners (via Triple P Securities, LLC) — also serves as Debtors' financial advisor / CTO provider (Triple P TRS, LLC)
stalking_horse_status: NONE DESIGNATED AS OF 2026-09-28. The Debtors entered chapter 11 without a stalking horse bid. As of the Sept 7, 2026 bidding procedures motion, Portage Point had contacted ~105 prospective buyers, ~25 of whom signed NDAs for diligence access. The Bidding Procedures Order (Docket #219, entered 9/26/26) preserves the Debtors' ability to designate a stalking horse bidder later, with bid protections, if it would maximize estate value. Deadline to designate one is October 23, 2026 (per Cash Collateral Milestones) / October 21-23, 2026 (per Bidding Procedures sale timeline).

notes: The bidding-procedures process is an OPEN auction process, not a pre-negotiated sale — any Qualified Bidder can participate. This is a meaningfully more uncertain path than a case that starts with a signed stalking-horse asset purchase agreement. Per Lansio Declaration (Docket #92), if a stalking horse is later designated, it would set a bidding floor. Court-approved bid procedures order was entered ahead of its own required deadline, signaling the case is proceeding on schedule so far.
